value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym for ages 1 to 3 with a parent - their site says Term 1 is Sept 14 to Nov 1 and Term 2 Nov 2 to Dec 20, and Term 1 registration opened Wed July 22 at 8am online. I could not pin down the weekday, time or price. I'll keep watching and text you when I do.
